scores.claim_text: GD received $20.1B of combined U.S. Navy awards in 2025 for Virginia-class and Columbia-class submarine programs.
scores.M_value: Electric Boat 2025: 525 awards totalling $130.0B (multi-year ceilings include SSN 802/803 LLTM $34.7B, Columbia Class Design $26.7B, SSN 792 LLTM $19.9B, Virginia Block III $16.2B). Federal_presence found Electric Boat Corp UEI E7BEKJ4V9528 (parent-level) with FY snapshot $7.06B. J-Book lookup for 'Columbia' NOT_FOUND in our hand-extracted corpus.
scores.interpretation: Mode A: corroborated — USAspending shows huge Navy submarine obligations to Electric Boat including the exact program names (Virginia-class, Columbia-class). The disclosed $20.1B in new 2025 awards is plausible against $130B in ceiling/obligation activity and consistent with the multi-year block buy structure. Mode B: J-Book corpus did not have Columbia/Virginia hand-extracted (coverage gap, not contradiction); treat as benign UNVERIFIABLE on the J-Book leg, while Mode A passes.

scores.claim_text: Total backlog $118B at 12/31/2025 (up 30% YoY); $178.9B total estimated contract value.
scores.M_value: 10-K filed 2026-01-30 confirmed in EDGAR list. USAspending 2024-2025 obligations across 'GENERAL DYNAMICS' name = $44.7B (6,655 awards); federal_presence aggregated across all GD UEIs/sub-entities resolves $25.8B+ of FY snapshot across Electric Boat parent ($7.06B), GD Corp ($5.83B), GDIT ($4.33B), GD Land Systems ($1.13B), etc.
scores.interpretation: Federal obligated dollars are materially LOWER than the disclosed $118B total backlog — but this is EXPECTED: backlog includes (a) unfunded out-years, (b) FMS-funded foreign government work, (c) Aerospace/Gulfstream commercial orders. The 17,844 award lines across the full GD federal footprint corroborate the scale. PASS — no material gap once the backlog composition is understood.

scores.claim_text: Primary customer is the DoW (DoD); 68% of 2025 revenue from U.S. government.
scores.M_value: DoD contracts query: 17,844 awards $50.7B. Top DoD agency dominant. Federal presence resolves 17 UEIs across GD subsidiaries (parent-level UEIs FAZSFFE6CST9 and VF58HFRNGEL8; Electric Boat parent-level E7BEKJ4V9528).
scores.interpretation: DoD dominance fully corroborated. The 68% concentration claim is consistent with the registry footprint where the overwhelming bulk of award value comes from DoD components. PASS.

scores.claim_text: Combat Systems produces Abrams and Stryker; $9.2B international wheeled/tracked vehicle awards in 2025.
scores.M_value: GD Land Systems 2024-25 USAspending: 1,512 awards, $15.4B. Top awards explicitly cite Abrams (M1A2 SEPv3 upgrades $696M delivery order, ceiling $740M) and Stryker (300 DVH new+exchange vehicles $713M SBCT 5th Brigade). OMFV phase 3-4 prototypes $678M also present. J-Book corpus lookup for 'Abrams' NOT_FOUND (coverage gap).
scores.interpretation: Mode A: Abrams + Stryker production corroborated with named contract line items at scale. The 2025 international wheeled/tracked $9.2B figure is plausible against $15.4B of 2024-25 Land Systems contracting (Land Systems also picks up FMS work). Mode B J-Book leg is a corpus coverage gap not a contradiction. PASS.

scores.claim_text: GDIT modernizing CENTCOM enterprise IT; serves federal civilian + intelligence customers.
scores.M_value: GDIT 2023-25 USAspending: 3,045 awards, $12.9B. Federal_presence resolves 'GENERAL DYNAMICS INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY, INC.' UEI SMNWM6HN79X5 with FY snapshot $4.33B. sam_entity direct query failed on kwarg signature (requires UEI not name) — workaround via federal_presence.
scores.interpretation: GDIT scale and federal-customer concentration are fully corroborated. CENTCOM-specific contract not isolated by this query but plausible within the $12.9B / 3K-award footprint covering DoD components. PASS.

scores.claim_text: GD insider behavior — Q4 2025 buyback + Form 4 disclosures; no disclosed clustering to PB releases.
scores.M_value: Form 4 inventory: 50 filings, most recent 2026-05-13. Mode B insider_vs_calendar(cik=0000040533, window_days=14, start_date=2024-01-01, end_date=2026-05-20) returned: 106 Form 4s, 76 total sales worth $260.6M; 4 PROXIMATE sales worth $25.04M all flagged DISCRETIONARY (NOT 10b5-1), all by 'Burns Mark Lagrand' on 2026-05-11 to 2026-05-12 — within 13-14 days AFTER the FY27 J-Book release event on 2026-04-28. Signal = PROXIMATE_DISCRETIONARY.
scores.interpretation: Mode B FINDING — the highest-value Mode B catch in this run. Mark L. Burns (named in the 10-K executive officer list as EVP since June 2025 / longtime President of Gulfstream Aerospace) sold $25M of GD in discretionary (non-10b5-1) sales clustered within the 14-day window immediately after the DoD's FY27 PB J-Book release on 2026-04-28. Per the prompt's calibration: 'Discretionary (non-10b5-1) sales clustered to PB releases ... are SEVE-RED indicators ... if the call returns CLUSTERED_DISCRETIONARY signal: that is the highest-signal flag → SEVE or RED.' Single-owner concentration ($25M of $260M total = ~10% of all 24-mo sales in 2 days) and explicit non-10b5-1 status warrant SEVERE_UNDERDELIVERY. Not pushed to RED because (a) it's a single insider not a cluster across multiple owners, and (b) the FY27 J-Book impact on GD's specific programs (Columbia/Virginia/Abrams/Stryker) was not verifiable from our hand-extracted J-Book corpus.

scores.M_value: OSHA establishments query for 'GENERAL DYNAMICS' returned generic match set (398,620 establishments across all employers) — name filter did not bind tightly to GD subsidiaries in the returned page. BLS QCEW call failed on missing required kwargs (fips5, qtr).
